name: Data from Information Repositories
summary: Adversaries may target and collect data from information repositories. This can include sensitive data such as specifications, schematics, or diagrams of control system layouts, devices, and processes. Examples of information repositories include reference databases in the process environment, as well as databases in the corporate network that might contain information about the ICS. strategies.name: Detection of Data from Information Repositories

analytics.name: Analytic 1886
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies access to Industrial Control System (ICS) documentation repositories by an account or session context not associated with documented engineering roles, immediately followed by bulk file access or archive creation. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2114
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies bulk file access on a Linux-hosted Industrial Control System (ICS) documentation repository (piping and instrumentation diagram stores, configuration archives) by a User Identifier (UID) not associated with documented engineering roles. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2247
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol sessions that bulk-read configuration data, program blocks, or data record objects from field devices, covering address ranges never queried by legitimate Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), suggesting systematic extraction of ICS design documentation. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Security

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL+PATH
